findings.title: Preserve shell quote removal when deciding hook relevance
findings.explanation: The new regex searches expanded command text before shell quote/backslash removal. A relative command such as python3 ./gate_'hook'.py or python3 ./gate_\hook.py executes gate_hook.py, but contains no literal gate_hook.py for this regex. _command_targets only retains absolute paths, so these entries disappear. Beside an exact 15-second binding, a real 5-second registration yields timeout_seconds=15 and deadline=113.5 at start=100. The combined quoted-fragment/semicolon spelling also disappears. This restores the deadline-overrun condition P1 was meant to close.
findings.evidence: All three command spellings were executed under sh in the temporary hook directory and printed the marker from the same temporary script. The unchanged exact-head harness_bound returned 15 for each. Plain relative and literal-semicolon controls correctly returned MISWIRED.
findings.requested_change: Combine conservative punctuation-aware relevance with shell-normalized token relevance; do not replace the latter with a raw-text-only name test. Keep numeric timeout binding structural. Add quote-fragment and backslash regressions beside a longer exact binding, including shell execution proof.
findings.limit: Executed shell invocation plus bound-function reproduction, not a live vendor timeout/kill experiment.

findings.title: Propagate duplicate-key evidence along the registration path
findings.explanation: Only dupes[id(hook_obj)] is consumed. Duplicate top-level hooks, duplicate PreToolUse keys, and duplicate group-level hooks keys are collected by object_pairs_hook but ignored when binding a surviving child. Repeating the same canonical registration in either occurrence at any of these three levels returns a clean 15-second bound, contrary to the rule that even agreeing duplicate critical declarations are MISWIRED. The PR description's no-registration fallback covers complete erasure only; it does not cover a surviving target registration.
findings.evidence: Three agreeing structural-duplicate fixtures independently returned timeout_seconds=15 and deadline=113.5. An entry-local duplicate timeout control correctly returned MISWIRED.
findings.requested_change: Carry relevant ancestor duplicate evidence to the binding decision, retaining enough occurrence/provenance information when duplicate keys overwrite values. Add regressions at each registration-bearing level, while keeping duplicates confined to unrelated hook objects irrelevant.
findings.limit: Protocol-conformance finding, not a measured disagreement with a vendor's last-wins JSON parser.
